raw_description:
Position Type: Full-time

Location: Philippines (Remote)

Schedule: PST

ABOUT THE COMPANY

OUR CLIENT IS A FAST-GROWING CREATIVE STUDIO BUILDING AN ALWAYS-ON EDITORIAL TEAM. THEY PRODUCE SHORT-FORM SOCIAL CONTENT AND VERTICAL EPISODIC DRAMA AT VOLUME FOR TOP-TIER CLIENTS, INCLUDING A PREMIUM APPAREL BRAND AND AN ENTERTAINMENT PLATFORM AIMING TO BECOME THE "NETFLIX OF GAMING." OPERATING WITH A PHILOSOPHY OF "THOUGHTFUL OUTPUT," OUR CLIENT BALANCES HIGH-VOLUME PRODUCTION WITH A DEEP CARE FOR EVERY SINGLE PIECE OF CONTENT CREATED.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a high-energy Short-Form Video Editor (Social & Hype Content) to join a specialized offshore production pod. Reporting directly to the Directors of Editorial, this role turns episode masters and raw footage into high-demand promotional assets. You are the editor who makes audiences show up for a launch, creating trailers, teasers, previews, and platform-native social cuts that build massive engagement.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Cut trailers, previews, teasers, drop announcements, and hype cuts from episode masters and raw gameplay.
- Write platform-native on-screen copy and captions using an authentic TikTok and YouTube Shorts voice rather than standard corporate marketing language.
- Produce fast-turnaround social cutdowns (5-to-15-second clips, quick trims, and hooked teasers) tailored to platform behaviors.
- Differentiate content strategies across platforms: optimize specifically for TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, Snap, and X.
- Maintain process discipline: name files to taxonomy, tag, file, and deliver assets with clear production notes.
- Flexibly support narrative gaming cuts or brand edits when pod workloads peak.

COMPETENCIES AND QUALIFICATIONS

MUST-HAVE

- Hype-Building Track Record: Demonstrated experience cutting promotional material that builds anticipation for a series, drop, launch, or creator event.
- Short-Form Social Mastery: Native understanding of TikTok, Shorts, and Reels algorithms and trends; knows why a video holds attention in the first second and why captions carry watch time.
- On-Screen Copywriting: Ability to write snappy, context-aware on-screen text and captions directly in English.
- Technical Proficiency: Fluent in Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve.
- Language & Communication: Excellent written English communication for seamless feedback and copy execution.
- Hardware Setup: Must own a machine capable of 4K multicam editing (Apple Silicon M2+ or PC with dedicated GPU and 16GB+ RAM), dual displays (at least one 1440p), fiber internet (25Mbps+ upload) with a backup line, a UPS, and professional mixing headphones/monitors.

Nice-to-Have

- Working knowledge of gaming culture (Roblox, Fortnite, GTA, Minecraft).
- Motion graphics capability in After Effects for dynamic text overlays and callouts.
- Experience utilizing AI tools for fast transcription, captioning, and selects.
- Basic graphic design skills in Photoshop or Figma for thumbnail and teaser creation.

Key Qualities

- Performance-Curious: Pays attention to content metrics and proactively suggests new hype formats based on what works.
- Self-Starter: Proactively pulls tasks from the queue rather than waiting for micro-assignments.
- End-to-End Owner: Delivers complete, packaged assets ready for publication.
- Adaptable & Fast: Knows how to balance a 5-minute quick trim with a 40-minute crafted trailer edit without sacrificing quality.
- Low Drama, High Output: Collaborative, clear, and dependable in a fast-paced creative environment.

WHAT WE OFFER

- 100% Remote Work - Work from anywhere in the Philippines.
- Career Growth Opportunities - Gain hands-on experience, and continuous learning.
- Collaborative & Innovative Team - Work alongside skilled professionals who value excellence.

APPLICATION PROCESS

We understand that searching for a new job can be challenging, and we're here to support you every step of the way. Our goal is to make the process as transparent and respectful as possible.

The interview process includes a Recruiter Interview, Client Interview, and Assessment. As part of the process, candidates complete a hands-on task during the technical interview. Throughout each stage, we keep you informed and provide feedback as quickly as possible, ensuring you feel valued and supported throughout your journey with us.
